dct_description_sm:
This data contains waste collection area boundaries, also indicating which day of the week household waste is picked up.

For more information on when your waste is collected, please consult the Collection Calendar on the City's website or download the free mobile app: https://www.cityofkingston.ca/residents/waste/collection-calendar.
